source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of the exact original XML verse substring, including written/read notes, not a normalized substitute.
source.public_versification_note: Public Deuteronomy 1–6 align directly with all 219 corresponding Hebrew records. Each original XML record is hashed in full.

key_decisions.decision: Preserves the foot-sole image and God's grant to another related people.
Keeps the double restraint and the divine land grant to Lot's descendants.
Keeps the retrospective Israel comparison without rewriting its chronology or softening destruction.
Keeps direct divine agency and the destructive hand image.
Preserves a second grant to Lot's descendants and its matching ban on aggression.
Preserves the repeated description and assigns destruction to the LORD as the source does.
Keeps the peace overture beside the preceding battle command without resolving the narrative tension.
Leaves the scope of the comparison with Esau and Moab open rather than harmonizing the passage with Numbers.
Retains both human refusal and explicitly purposive divine hardening without substituting mere permission.
Follows the source's read form his sons rather than the singular written form and records both in the source binding.
Preserves the ban term alongside explicit victims and total killing; no euphemistic displacement language.
